name: Kent Coast Assistance Foodbank
short_description: Kent Coast Assistance Foodbank in Folkestone
description: Based at St Mary's Church. Emergency food parcels with referral. Open Tue and Fri 10am-2pm. Part of the Trussell Trust network.

name: Folkestone & Hythe Council Allotments
description: Multiple sites including Sandgate Road and Black Bull Road. Plots from £35/year. Water access and storage facilities available.

name: Folkestone East Community Garden
description: Volunteer project near the harbour. Grows seasonal vegetables with surplus distributed to local families. Open weekends for volunteers.
